meta.methodology: Stocks discussed AS AN OPPORTUNITY (buy pitches, upgrades, target raises, 'undervalued / top pick' features) across financial and public sources in the window. Score = verified analyst action (upgrade, target raise, bullish initiation) 3 pts per firm; major-outlet opportunity feature or fund-manager pitch 2 pts per outlet; trending-list appearance 1 pt per list; verified bullish social discussion 1 pt per platform (capped at 2). A name needs at least 2 distinct sources to be listed. Social evidence scored 0 for every name in this edition: the platforms carrying ticker discussion (StockTwits, Reddit, X) could not be read for verification, and unverified chatter is never scored.
